name: safetylab-sysml-checks
description: Two independent SysML v2 validators the Safety Lab SysML v2 tests run every export through (13 Oct 2026, same pins as Sys Lab). Install with: npm install (in this folder). Not shipped with Safety Lab. The OpenMBEE service binary for this computer comes with @openmbee/opensysml (macOS, Linux and Windows builds).
